title: Briar-Oath Duelist
text: Briar-Oath Duelist offers safe passage, then attacks through the unspoken exception hidden in the bargain. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: The promise was sincere. The wording was hungry.

defeatReward.text: Briar-Oath Duelist is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
